name: English Muffin with Cream Cheese, Blueberries & Honey
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the English muffins.)
Split muffins and arrange on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide cream cheese between muffin halves and spread out in an even layer.
To serve, divide muffin halves between plates, top with blueberries, and drizzle with honey. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
